source_block.parva: Vana Parva · Jayadratha’s abduction of Draupadi · Pandava pursuit · hard mercy
source_block.divergence: BORI CE / Debroy place Jayadratha’s sighting of Draupadi at the hermitage, the abduction, the brothers’ chase, Bhima’s fury, and Yudhishthira’s hard mercy (Jayadratha spared, shamed) in Vana. Ganguli’s vulgate English maps the same beats under Vana Parva Jayadratha sections. Gita Press Gorakhpur tells the same abduction–pursuit–mercy arc under its Vana numbering. Beats agree: alone → sighting → soft words → seize → cry → chase → catch → mercy → quiet resolve. Humiliation details (e.g. head-shaving) vary by recension; this episode keeps tasteful shame without gore.
source_block.chosen: Gita Press Gorakhpur + BORI overlap for the abduction–pursuit–mercy itself. Debroy for BORI beat map. Ganguli for English chase/mercy wording.
source_block.notes: Not TV. Comic-mythology only — distress without sexualization or gore. Never attach Ep01 plate-wide-gold or this episode’s plate-wide-gold as Imagine refs. Draupadi: deep red sari, dignity. Arjuna: Ep 09 face family; cream exile dhoti; no peacock.
